<div class="card-body">
'''Grand Moff Tarkin''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">グランドモフ・ターキン</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーと同じ戦闘に参加していれば、敵が運命数を求めて見せた後で、1枚だけキャンセルすることができる。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋2になる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">リーダー。アウターリムの統治者。デス・スター司令官。帝国元老院の解散に功があった。恐怖統治の原則を打ち立てたデス・スターを、皇帝への謀反に使おうと画策していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Grand Moff Tarkin.

'''Card text:''' If participating in the same battle as Vader, may cancel just one card after the enemy reveals it to determine destiny. A starship he pilots gets power +2.

'''Lore:''' Leader. Governor of the Outer Rim. Death Star commander. Played a part in dissolving the Imperial Senate. He was plotting to use the Death Star, which established the principle of rule through fear, in a rebellion against the Emperor.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Grand Moff Tarkin|Grand Moff Tarkin]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R12 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Grand-Moff-Tarkin-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
